scenarios.lesson: A long cycle, rising trend, short cycle, quiet shelf, and reversal expose each adaptive state.
A noise-free control makes phase progression and half-cycle fast attacks easy to inspect.
A level jump followed by changing slopes shows MAMA's ratchet and FAMA's slower response.
A flat series and epsilon-scale cycle exercise zero I/Q divisions and scale sensitivity.
